headline: 162* : West Indies beat India in record chase led by Shai Hope
summary: Skipper Shai Hope overcame a groin injury to smash an unbeaten 162, guiding the Windies to a five-wicket victory in the final ODI.
details: West Indies secured a consolation five-wicket victory over India in the final one-day international on Saturday, denying India a clean sweep of the series.
Captain Shai Hope produced a masterclass, scoring an unbeaten 162 runs. He overcame a groin injury and a sudden change in batting order to lead the record-breaking chase.
India had posted a mammoth 351-7, powered by KL Rahul's career-best 129 not out and Rohit Sharma's 92. However, Hope's innings was the difference.
Hope's late-game onslaught was particularly striking, smashing 40 runs off his final 16 deliveries to bring home the win with 10 balls to spare.
Earlier in the match, Jayden Seales caused early damage for the Windies, dismissing both Shubman Gill and Virat Kohli in quick succession.
Hope mentioned that advice from MS Dhoni on maintaining composure during a chase was key to his match-winning performance.
Despite the win, India won the three-match series 2-0, as West Indies suffered losses in the first two games.
caption:
An unbeaten 162 and a record chase! Shai Hope fights through injury to deny India a clean sweep.

West Indies secured a consolation five-wicket victory over India in the final one-day international on Saturday, denying India a clean sweep of the series.

Captain Shai Hope produced a masterclass, scoring an unbeaten 162 runs. He overcame a groin injury and a sudden change in batting order to lead the record-breaking chase.

India had posted a mammoth 351-7, powered by KL Rahul's career-best 129 not out and Rohit Sharma's 92. However, Hope's innings was the difference.

Hope's late-game onslaught was particularly striking, smashing 40 runs off his final 16 deliveries to bring home the win with 10 balls to spare.

Earlier in the match, Jayden Seales caused early damage for the Windies, dismissing both Shubman Gill and Virat Kohli in quick succession.

Hope mentioned that advice from MS Dhoni on maintaining composure during a chase was key to his match-winning performance.

Despite the win, India won the three-match series 2-0, as West Indies suffered losses in the first two games.

headline_marked: 7-0 thrashing: [[England rout Croatia]] in Nations League
headline: 7-0 thrashing: England rout Croatia in Nations League
summary: Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka score twice each as England dismantle Croatia in a dominant display in Rijeka.
details: England delivered a rampant display in Rijeka on Saturday, defeating Croatia 7-0 in their third League A, Group Three match at the Rujevica stadium.
Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka each scored twice, while Jude Bellingham scored one goal and provided three assists in a dominant performance.
Anthony Gordon and substitute Morgan Rogers also found the net as England overwhelmed a struggling Croatian defence.
Captain Harry Kane marked his 124th international appearance with his 88th and 89th goals, moving him within one cap of Peter Shilton's national record.
Kane is set to draw level with the record if he plays against the Czech Republic on Tuesday, and could potentially break it on November 12 against Croatia at Wembley.
England now sit level with Spain on six points in the group, though Spain holds a game in hand.
caption:
A 7-0 demolition! England completely dismantles Croatia in a masterclass of clinical finishing.

England delivered a rampant display in Rijeka on Saturday, defeating Croatia 7-0 in their third League A, Group Three match at the Rujevica stadium.

Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka each scored twice, while Jude Bellingham scored one goal and provided three assists in a dominant performance.

Anthony Gordon and substitute Morgan Rogers also found the net as England overwhelmed a struggling Croatian defence.

Captain Harry Kane marked his 124th international appearance with his 88th and 89th goals, moving him within one cap of Peter Shilton's national record.

Kane is set to draw level with the record if he plays against the Czech Republic on Tuesday, and could potentially break it on November 12 against Croatia at Wembley.

England now sit level with Spain on six points in the group, though Spain holds a game in hand.
